name: nibbi
description: Nibbi — Oracle's new face: a little ink-blot character at the center of the app. Zero-build web surface + zero-dep host that proxies to the Oracle gateway.

scripts.deploy: cd desktop && npm i --no-audit --no-fund && npx tauri build && rm -rf "$HOME/Applications/Nibbi.app" && cp -R "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-src-tauri/target}/release/bundle/macos/Nibbi.app" "$HOME/Applications/Nibbi.app" && echo "Nibbi.app installed"
scripts.release:app: cd "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-desktop/src-tauri/target}/release/bundle/macos" && rm -f Nibbi.app.zip && ditto -c -k --keepParent Nibbi.app Nibbi.app.zip && echo "$(pwd)/Nibbi.app.zip"
